# Discava! - Your Vinyl Digging Experience

Discava! is a premium web platform dedicated to vinyl records, specifically focusing on soul, funk, and disco music. It integrates with the Discogs API to provide a seamless record digging experience.

## Core Features
- **Vinyl Search**: Advanced search functionality by artist, title, or label.
- **Genre Filtering**: Specialized filters for soul, funk, and disco.
- **Favorites & Playlists**: Users can save their favorite records and create YouTube playlists.
- **Discogs Integration**: Direct links to view and buy records on Discogs.
- **Responsive Design**: Premium, dark-themed UI optimized for all devices.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3 (Custom Design System), and JavaScript (ES Modules).
- **Architecture**: MVC-pattern inspired modular JS (Models, Views, Controllers).
- **APIs**: Discogs API for record data, YouTube for music playback.
- **Tracking**: Google Tag Manager and GA4 for event measurement.

## Key Pages
- [/index.html](https://dev.juanfalibene.com/discava/index.html): Main digging interface.
- [/about.html](https://dev.juanfalibene.com/discava/about.html): Project information and contact form.
- [/listen.html](https://dev.juanfalibene.com/discava/listen.html): User's saved favorites and playlist generator.
- [/single.html](https://dev.juanfalibene.com/discava/single.html): Detailed view for individual records.
